overall_summary: The strongest plausible refinement candidates are the downstream decision CPTs Network_Manipulation and Root_Causes. Both show failure-specific activations with little or no success support, and both occupy structurally decisive positions in the BN where overconfident probability assignments can repeatedly turn packet/log evidence into incorrect cyberattack diagnoses. Other candidate CPTs are either evidence priors, heavily shared by successful cases, or more plausibly reflecting upstream activations than independently causing repeated errors.
